en: An old monochrome photograph showing a large rural gathering in a hilly landscape. In the foreground, men and women in traditional Eastern European folk costumes stand in a row playing very long wooden horns laid on the ground and pointed slightly upward. Many more people in similar attire fill the background fields, suggesting a festival or folk celebration in a mountainous countryside.
